games.title: The Golden Keep: Forces of Darkness
games.description: Development demo 0.9.13-overmind.1 for Windows and Linux, with the normal RTS player and optional Overmind balance lab. Extract the entire archive before running Goldenkeep. Game balance is unchanged by the lab; player/art acceptance remains open.

games.title: Iron Litany
games.description: Playable early edition. A heavier, immediate cannon with a complete steel-and-bass decay; seven new original sound clips; 384 fighting infantry and 480 fallen bodies behind narrow slit views; clearer wax counts and one adult loader/contact refinement. Both matching desktop editions passed actual aiming, interrupted paid work and three watches through calibrated ordinary expert input. Human play, listening and Diablo I art remain in review.

games.title: Pixie Garden
games.description: Linux 1.2.1 development demo. Extract the complete folder and run PixieGarden.x86_64. Windows and controller coverage remain in development.

games.title: Chantilly
games.description: Windows and Linux demo with the corrected menu cursor and current entrance hall. The macOS download remains the earlier July release.

games.title: Golden Keep: Golden Ocean
games.description: Download the complete Windows or Linux demo, extract it, and start the game. No additional runtime installation is needed.

games.title: Golden Keep: Golden Cliffs
games.description: Windows and Linux climbing lesson and exploration slice with the September 30 walking update. Start with Find Your Feet. The complete route and Windows playthrough still need testing.

games.title: Golden Keep: Jabberwocky
games.description: October 3 development demo: the authored world, regional injuries, finite treatment, wind flight, Skyfall and swimming. Prototype animation and performance need further testing. Windows play still needs testing on a Windows PC.

games.title: The Dark Between Stations
games.description: Windows and Linux demo with improved ambience and sound playback. Early game build; the full campaign remains in development.

games.title: Inhospitable
games.description: October 1 Windows and Linux development demo. The macOS download remains the earlier v0.1.0 release. See build notes for the exact version.

games.title: Your Happy Place
games.description: Public Windows and Linux demo updated October 3. macOS remains the earlier v0.1.0 release. Extract the complete archive before launching.

games.title: Echoes of Elsewhere
games.description: Current Living Wilds 1.1.0 local browser demo. Python 3.10+ and a modern browser are required. Extract the complete ZIP and run launch.py. The actual state/action/save server is included; no account or external service is required.

games.title: Echoes of Elsewhere TCG
games.description: Portable local edition for Windows, macOS and Linux. Python 3 and a browser are required; extract the complete folder before playing. The card game also plays directly in your browser.

games.title: War Table
games.description: Linux x86-64 local browser development demo. Requires Python 3.10+ and a modern browser; Java 25 and the pinned TripleA runtime are included. Extract the complete ZIP, run sh Start-War-Table.sh, then open http://127.0.0.1:8795/play. If needed, run sh Start-War-Table.sh --port 8796 and open http://127.0.0.1:8796/play. Personal saves are excluded.

games.title: Poot-Poot
games.description: Play the six-rescue browser prototype online, or download the same game for offline play on Windows, macOS or Linux. The download requires Python 3 and a modern browser. Extract the complete ZIP and open its launcher; saves stay in that browser.
